edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive the Base Salary specified in Schedule A, plus benefits. Base Salary: [OPEN — amount and payment terms to be agreed]. Schedule A: Compensation (to be completed). The parties will address any applicable bonus, equity, and benefits terms in Schedule A or the applicable plan documents.

3. SEVERANCE. On termination without cause, the Executive receives the Severance Amount specified in Schedule B. Severance Amount: [OPEN — amount and payment terms to be agreed]. Schedule B: Severance (to be completed). Any conditions, release requirements, timing, and benefits continuation terms remain to be agreed.
4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not compete for twelve months after departure. This provision remains subject to further discussion and review, including as to scope and enforceability.
